Reflection: complete materials and nine steps, slit/mirror/white paper setup, reflected-ray marking, normal construction, angle measurements and repeated comparison retained. The 402/403 page break does not merge distinct steps.

Glass: complete materials and ten steps, plane-parallel faces, A/B/C tracing, normal, incidence/refraction symbols, sin(alpha)/sin(beta), repetition and fig278/caption retained. The 403/404 break keeps steps 5 and 6 separate.

Concave mirror: six steps, virtual-image observation, arm-length setup, eye/axis placement, inverted real-image observation and smaller/equal/larger image constructions retained. ZH virtual-image character modernization preserves meaning.

Lens images: nine steps plus the independent approximate-focal-length explanation. Distant object, concave-mirror letter support, 2 focal lengths, millimeter grid, all four parallax eye movements, width/height, distances, ratio orientation and repetition retained.

Focal length/power: all nine steps, slit screen, filament focus, lamp/image distances and all four formula expressions retained. Current EN prose73 preserves the exact formula/reference order; the prior D493 FAIL is not erased.

Microscope: materials across 406/407, three steps plus the separate final eyepiece paragraph, objective/eyepiece roles, greater-than-objective-focus condition, Experiment 5 cross-reference, enlarged inverted real intermediate image and equal-or-less eyepiece-focus condition retained.

Dispersion: materials and four steps complete. Hydrogen/neon/helium material order and hydrogen/helium/neon observation order preserved, along with 45/60 degrees, continuous versus line spectra and brightest-line recording. ZH prose88 alone corrupts the explanatory separator into a repeated range word; EN remains faithful.

Interference: two glass plates and all five steps, cleaning/contact/pressure, reflected light with black background and glare exclusion, colored rings or irregular fringes, pressure-dependent shape/location, and attempted transmitted-light observation retained.

Diffraction: one shared straight-filament lamp, vernier caliper and all four steps retained. The 408/409 split joins only the unfinished sentence in step 3. 0.5 mm initial slit, source 0.55-to-0.8 mm later change, both-side colored fringes, marker 1 and its full glass-photographic-plate fallback footnote retained.

modern-us-neutral.text: 2. 把灯放在桌子的一边，屏放在另一边，透镜放在它们之间。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 4. Measure the lamp-to-lens distance and the lens-to-screen distance.

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 5. Use the formula $F=\frac{fd}{f+d}$ to calculate the principal focal length of the lens, and calculate its optical power from $D=1/F$.

blocks.rawText: **仪器和材料：**

modern-us-neutral.text: **仪器和材料：**

modern-us-neutral-en.text: **Apparatus and materials:**

blocks.rawText: 长焦距的会聚透镜，短焦距的会聚透镜，画有毫米格的玻璃，导杆，背面贴有纸做的字母的凹面镜.

modern-us-neutral.text: 长焦距的会聚透镜，短焦距的会聚透镜，画有毫米格的玻璃，导杆，背面贴有纸做的字母的凹面镜。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: A long-focal-length converging lens, a short-focal-length converging lens, a glass plate marked with a millimeter grid, a guide rod, and a concave mirror with a paper letter attached to its back.

blocks.rawText: **实验步骤：**

modern-us-neutral.text: **实验步骤：**

modern-us-neutral-en.text: **Procedure:**

blocks.rawText: 1. 沿着导杆把短焦距的会聚透镜（*物镜*）安装在被照得很亮的字母附近，两者间的距离比该透镜的焦距要稍微大一些. 透镜的焦距应是事先已知的.

modern-us-neutral.text: 1. 沿着导杆把短焦距的会聚透镜（*物镜*）安装在被照得很亮的字母附近，两者间的距离比该透镜的焦距要稍微大一些。 透镜的焦距应是事先已知的。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 1. Along the guide rod, place the short-focal-length converging lens (the *objective*) near the brightly illuminated letter. The distance between them should be slightly greater than the focal length of this lens. Its focal length should be known beforehand.

blocks.rawText: 2. 利用有毫米格的玻璃，用视差的方法（见实验 $5$）找到字母的放大的倒立实像.

modern-us-neutral.text: 2. 利用有毫米格的玻璃，用视差的方法（见实验 $5$）找到字母的放大的倒立实像。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 2. Use the glass plate with a millimeter grid and the parallax method (see Experiment $5$) to locate the enlarged, inverted real image of the letter.

blocks.rawText: 3. 沿着导杆，在像后边的某个距离上安装第二个透镜（*目镜*）. 让这个距离等于该透镜的焦距或比焦距稍微小一些（目镜的焦距也应事先已知）.

modern-us-neutral.text: 3. 沿着导杆，在像后边的某个距离上安装第二个透镜（*目镜*）。 让这个距离等于该透镜的焦距或比焦距稍微小一些（目镜的焦距也应事先已知）。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 3. Along the guide rod, place the second lens (the *eyepiece*) at a distance behind the image. Make this distance equal to, or slightly less than, the focal length of the eyepiece. Its focal length should also be known beforehand.

blocks.rawText: 撤去毫米格玻璃，像用放大镜那样，用目镜来观察字母的放大的像.

modern-us-neutral.text: 撤去毫米格玻璃，像用放大镜那样，用目镜来观察字母的放大的像。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: Remove the glass plate with the millimeter grid. Use the eyepiece like a magnifying glass to observe the enlarged image of the letter.

modern-us-neutral-en.text: A projector, spectrum tubes containing hydrogen, neon, or helium, a high-voltage induction coil, a battery pack, a stand, and connecting wires (shared by all classes); and a glass plate with beveled edges for each person.

blocks.rawText: **实验步骤：**

modern-us-neutral.text: **实验步骤：**

blocks.rawText: 1. 把玻璃板水平地放在眼睛的前面，透过 $45^\circ$ 角的边观察屏幕上的明亮竖条纹——投影仪所分开的狭缝的像.

modern-us-neutral.text: 1. 把玻璃板水平地放在眼睛的前面，透过 $45^\circ$ 角的边观察屏幕上的明亮竖条纹至至投影仪所分开的狭缝的像。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 1. Hold the glass plate horizontally in front of your eyes. Look through its $45^\circ$ edge at the bright vertical strip on the screen: the image of the slit projected by the projector.

blocks.rawText: 2. 分辨所获得的连续光谱的各基本颜色，按观察到的顺序把它们记录下来.

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 2. Identify the principal colors of the continuous spectrum and record them in the order observed.

blocks.rawText: 3. 通过 $60^\circ$ 角的边观察条纹，重复实验，记下不同形式的光谱.

modern-us-neutral.text: 3. 通过 $60^\circ$ 角的边观察条纹，重复实验，记下不同形式的光谱。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 3. Repeat the experiment by observing the strip through the $60^\circ$ edge. Record the different appearance of the spectrum.

modern-us-neutral.text: 4. 透过玻璃板的两个边观察正在发光的光谱管，观察氢、氦或氖的线光谱，记下光谱中最亮的线。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 4. View the glowing spectrum tubes through both edges of the glass plate. Observe the line spectra of hydrogen, helium, or neon, and record the brightest lines.

modern-us-neutral-en.text: An incandescent lamp with a straight filament (one for the class) and a vernier caliper.

blocks.rawText: **实验步骤：**

modern-us-neutral.text: **实验步骤：**

modern-us-neutral-en.text: **Procedure:**

blocks.rawText: 1. 在游标卡尺的齿之间形成一个 $0.5$ 毫米宽的狭缝.

modern-us-neutral.text: 1. 在游标卡尺的齿之间形成一个 $0.5$ 毫米宽的狭缝。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 1. Form a slit $0.5$ mm wide between the jaws of the vernier caliper.

blocks.rawText: 2. 让狭缝竖直地紧靠眼睛.

modern-us-neutral.text: 2. 让狭缝竖直地紧靠眼睛。

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 2. Hold the slit vertically close to your eye.

blocks.rawText: 3. 穿过狭缝观看灯的竖直放置的发光的线. 在线的两侧有七色条纹（衍射光谱）.

modern-us-neutral-en.text: 3. Look through the slit at the vertically positioned glowing filament of the lamp. Multicolored fringes (diffraction spectra) appear on both sides of the filament.

blocks.rawText: 4. 把狭缝的宽度由 $0.55$ 毫米加宽到 $0.8$ 毫米，观察对衍射光谱有何影响①.
